scientific_integrity: Mathematical argument in RESULT.md; finite checks cover all graph isomorphism types through eight vertices with capacities through five. Those checks are not an infinite proof. Literature-priority uncertainty remains; no external independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected simple graphs of maximum degree two, symmetric unit-valued friendship edges, groups and deviations size at most k, weak blockers (strict-core notion). Heterogeneous, negative, or higher-degree networks and ordinary core not covered. Formula gives exact counting, not a polynomial-time counting bound when k varies.
title: A divisibility and weighted-Bell census of strict-core partitions on degree-two friendship networks
